unit.why: An anecdote: a woman whose child died in her care comes to the Apter Rav, who rules her penitential fasts should be converted to money, and recalls defending this view in his youth before an assembly at Zlotchov; it is framed by a halakhic note on easing fasts.

stories.start_quote: בליקוטים שבסוף ס׳ שפצ"ד שבדורות הללו
stories.summary_en: The Apter Rav rules that a woman whose child died beside her should redeem her penitential fasts with money rather than weaken herself and lose future pregnancies, and recalls winning the same argument in his youth against the local rabbi at a gathering with R. Yehiel Mikhel of Zlotchov.
